create_user_with_email: create a user with an email address and password using UserManager.create_user
create_superuser_with_email: create a superuser with email, password, and admin privileges using UserManager.create_superuser
update_user_last_activity: update a user's last activity timestamp with optional Redis caching via UserLastActivityMixin
get_user_token: get or reset an authentication token for a user instance using get_token or reset_token
get_user_initials: get the initials for a user based on first and last name or email using get_initials
